e.title: Contoso Claims (LangGraph)
e.summary: LangGraph+Azure GPT-4.1 多智能代理理赔平台（35★）：评估/保单/风险/沟通/主管代理协作
e.body: Contoso Claims（alisoliman/insurance-multi-agent，35★）是基于 LangGraph 与 Azure OpenAI（GPT-4.1）的多智能代理理赔演示：专项代理协作评估理赔——理赔评估代理（损伤照片/维修成本/一致性）、保单核查代理（条款/资格）、风险分析代理（欺诈模式/索赔历史）、沟通代理（客户邮件/补件请求）、主管代理（工作流编排与综合建议），把理赔处理从小时级缩短到分钟级。对 RIAA：多代理理赔的 **LangGraph 编排范式**——与 [[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry/MCP）、[[agentic-ai-hack]]（Semantic Kernel）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（A2A 协议）对照三种主流编排路线；欺诈检测代理与 [[claims-fraud-guardian]] 同类。

e.summary_en: LangGraph + Azure GPT-4.1 multi-agent claims platform (35★): assessor / policy / risk / communication / supervisor agents collaborating
e.summary_hk: LangGraph+Azure GPT-4.1 多智能代理理賠平台（35★）：評估/保單/風險/溝通/主管代理協作
e.body_en: Contoso Claims (alisoliman/insurance-multi-agent, 35★) is a multi-agent insurance-claims demo built on LangGraph and Azure OpenAI (GPT-4.1): specialised agents collaborate to assess claims — a Claim Assessor agent (damage photos, repair costs, consistency), Policy Checker agent (coverage terms, eligibility), Risk Analyst agent (fraud patterns, claimant history), Communication agent (customer emails, missing-document requests) and a Supervisor agent (workflow orchestration and final recommendations) — cutting claim handling from hours to minutes. For RIAA: the LangGraph orchestration paradigm for multi-agent claims — compare the three mainstream orchestration routes: [[claims-processing-hack]] (Foundry/MCP), [[agentic-ai-hack]] (Semantic Kernel) and [[insurancea2amcp]] (A2A protocol); the fraud-detection agent parallels [[claims-fraud-guardian]].
e.body_hk: Contoso Claims（alisoliman/insurance-multi-agent，35★）是基於 LangGraph 與 Azure OpenAI（GPT-4.1）的多智能代理理賠演示：專項代理協作評估理賠——理賠評估代理（損傷照片/維修成本/一致性）、保單核查代理（條款/資格）、風險分析代理（欺詐模式/索賠歷史）、溝通代理（客戶電郵/補件請求）、主管代理（工作流編排與綜合建議），把理賠處理從小時級縮短到分鐘級。對 RIAA：多代理理賠的 LangGraph 編排範式——與 [[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry/MCP）、[[agentic-ai-hack]]（Semantic Kernel）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（A2A 協議）對照三種主流編排路線；欺詐檢測代理與 [[claims-fraud-guardian]] 同類。
